title: AuditEvent
description: One stored record of the per-tenant tamper-evident audit ledger (issue #31). Each record is chained to the previous by prevHash; hash is the sha256 of the canonical JSON of every other field. Sensitive payloads are stored only as the encrypted payloadEnc envelope (AES-256-GCM); clear payloads never appear in the ledger. The authoritative python-side validator is telemetry/ledger/schema.py.

ts.description: When the action happened, RFC 3339 UTC.

tenantId.description: The tenant (agent org) whose chain this record belongs to.

actor.description: Canonical 'kind:id' principal that caused the action.

impersonatedBy.description: Optional impersonation stamp - the principal the actor acted on behalf of.

action.description: What was done, e.g. model.call, registry.register, policy.decision.

resource.description: What resource the action concerned, e.g. gateway/proxy.

evidence.description: Optional pointer to external supporting evidence (e.g. a source log hash).

modelUsed.description: Model id when the action was a model call.

costUsd.description: Cost in USD when relevant (number or decimal string).

payloadEnc.description: Encrypted envelope of the sensitive payload (AES-256-GCM); null when no payload. The clear payload is never stored.

prevHash.description: Hash of the previous record in this tenant's chain; the fixed genesis hash for seq 1.

hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of every other field.
